context_build.causal_mechanism: Test whether a fully priced 25bp Fed hike plus an energy-CPI scare has been over-extrapolated into 2027H1 SOFR. Mechanism: once the hike is in overnight SOFR, additional implied tightening requires a persistent inflation impulse. If energy-tail risk fades and lagging tightening (housing, financial conditions) bites, the extra 73bp to SR3H7 mean-reverts via lower implied rates (bull-steepener), not via more hikes.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Multi-horizon US rates: 2Y +57bp 1m / +13bp 5d / +9bp 1d to 4.76; 5Y +51bp 1m to 4.86; 10Y +36bp 1m to 5.01. 2s10s flattened 21bp over 1m to 25bp. Policy path: overnight SOFR 3.85 after the 16 Sep hike; 1m SOFR builds from Oct 3.91 through Apr 4.525; 3m SR3 goes 4.00 (Sep) / 4.32 (Dec) / 4.58 (Mar 27) / 4.72 (Jun) / 4.755 (Sep 27 peak). Pre-meeting futures had >90% probability of the 25bp hike. August CPI kept the tightening bias intact; BoJ then hiked to 1.25%. Desk thesis: energy shock is constraining global easing and keeping term-rate pressure elevated.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known before/at the meeting: >90% hike odds, August CPI bias, energy-shock narrative. Now realized: the 25bp hike and the 23bp official-SOFR jump 3.62 to 3.85. Genuinely newer offsets: Saudi STS workaround reducing the extreme oil-supply tail with modest oil easing. What is not new is another 73-90bp of extra tightening still in SR3 — that is the same hawkish path being re-asserted after known news, which requires a new transmission mechanism the packet does not supply beyond continued energy/CPI worry.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: SR3H7 at 4.58 and the strip peak at 4.755 assume roughly three additional 25bp-equivalent tightenings from overnight 3.85 by 2027H1-H3, with US 2Y/5Y/10Y remaining at 1y extremes and 2s10s staying near its 1y floor. That path treats the Sep hike as the start of a renewed cycle, not as a largely priced adjustment.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: Disagree that the residual energy-CPI impulse plus still-warm US gauges (inflation 72, labor 75) justify another ~73bp of tightening by Mar 2027 after a hike that was already >90% priced. The priced assumption that is wrong is the extra path, not the hike that already printed.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level: US 2Y 4.76 sits ~91bp above overnight SOFR 3.85; SR3H7 4.58 is the 3m 2027H1 window (+73bp). Change: the 1m 57bp 2Y rally and 21bp 2s10s flattening are the marginal hawkish squeeze. Tenor: the 3m strip, not 30Y (30Y +15bp 1m, less of the squeeze). Driver: policy-path repricing around the hike/CPI/energy cluster rather than a long-end term-premium shock; 1m SOFR already shows the near-dated averaging of the hike (Sep 3.75, Oct 3.91) while 2027 contracts keep stacking extra hikes.

2023 US STIR after the hiking cycle neared terminal: additional hikes remained in the reds/greens and were later faded as the inflation impulse cooled, even while labor stayed firm for a time.

trade.mispricing: The extra 73bp in SOFR_2027-03 versus overnight 3.85 is the overshoot. The 25bp hike is already in the overnight benchmark; the residual path treats a priced meeting as the start of a new hiking cycle. 99th-percentile yields and a 0.2nd-percentile 2s10s are the distributional signature of that extrapolation, not independent proof.
